Services

From event to insight, in production.

Six services for companies that need data in motion to operate and to feed their AI. From architecture design to real-time decisions, with the technology license included when it makes sense.

01

Architecture for Event-Driven solutions

Point-to-point integrations, duplicated data and teams that don’t share a language about the business. We design the event architecture before the first line of code.

Deliverables
  • Event Storming with business and technology
  • Domain map, bounded contexts and event catalog
  • Topic, partition and key design
  • Data contracts with Schema Registry and evolution rules
  • Governance model: ownership, naming and RBAC
Technologies
Event StormingApache KafkaSchema RegistryAvro · ProtobufData ContractsStream Governance
Illustrative diagram
02

Event-Driven Pipelines

Data locked in legacy databases and batch jobs that arrive late. We build pipelines that capture change the moment it happens and deliver data ready to consume.

Deliverables
  • Change data capture (CDC) from Oracle, DB2, SQL Server, Postgres and mainframe
  • Source and sink Kafka Connect connectors
  • Processing with Apache Flink: enrichment, joins and filters
  • Data contracts enforced at the source (shift-left)
  • Pipelines as code, with CI/CD and tests
Technologies
Kafka ConnectDebezium · CDCApache FlinkConfluent CloudTerraform
Illustrative diagram
03

Real-Time Analytics

Yesterday’s dashboards for today’s decisions. We take data from event to dashboard in seconds, with the same stream feeding the lakehouse.

Deliverables
  • Continuous metrics and aggregations with Flink SQL
  • Tableflow: topics as Iceberg tables in the lakehouse
  • Serving layer for dashboards and alerts
  • Anomaly detection and real-time rules
  • Reconciliation between stream and batch
Technologies
Apache FlinkFlink SQLTableflowApache IcebergDatabricks · Snowflake · BigQueryGrafana
Illustrative diagram
04

Streaming Platform

The platform must be secure, observable and cost-controlled before it scales. We deploy and assess Confluent and Kafka in the cloud, on-prem or hybrid.

Deliverables
  • Confluent Cloud, Platform (CFK on Kubernetes) and Private Cloud setup
  • Security: RBAC, mTLS, BYOK and auditing
  • Observability: metrics, lag, alerts and tracing
  • FinOps: sizing, Tiered Storage and cluster types
  • Health Check and Assessment with a technical report
Technologies
Confluent CloudConfluent PlatformCFKConfluent Private CloudLenses.ioPrometheus · GrafanaTerraform
Illustrative diagram
Streaming Platform · Assessment

Streaming platform Health Check

Diagnosis of Confluent and Kafka clusters, on Platform or Cloud. The deliverable is a technical report.

Request an assessment →
ScorecardRating for each dimension of the platform.
FindingsIssues ranked by severity.
Action planPrioritized fixes, from quick wins to roadmap.
05

Legacy Modernization

MQ, Tibco and batch ETL keep the business running but block evolution. We migrate in waves, with no big bang and no downtime.

Deliverables
  • Legacy assessment and wave plan
  • Coexistence: MQ ↔ Kafka bridges during the transition
  • Mainframe decoupling through CDC and events
  • IBM Event Streams → Confluent migration with our own framework
  • Decommissioning with evidence
Technologies
IBM MQTibcoIBM Event StreamsKafka ConnectCluster LinkingCDC
Illustrative diagram
06

Real-Time AI

Models trained on yesterday’s data decide with stale context. We deliver features, inference and LLM context at the moment of the event.

Deliverables
  • Real-time feature store fed by streams
  • Low-latency inference in the event flow
  • Streaming RAG: always-fresh context for LLMs
  • Drift monitoring and feedback loop
Technologies
Apache FlinkConfluentFeature storeVector DB
Illustrative diagram
Training and enablement

Apache Kafka, Confluent and Flink tracks so your team can own the operation: from fundamentals to advanced, in workshops or dedicated cohorts.

See Academy →
Service and licensing

Not just services. The license comes with us, end to end.

Intelium also resells the technology. One counterpart from sizing to the signed contract, so the customer does not have to coordinate consultancy, vendor and distributor separately.

01Sizing

We measure volume, retention and growth and translate it into CKUs, brokers or Flink capacity. Nothing oversized, nothing short.

02Commercial proposal

We build the proposal together with the vendor (IBM Confluent, Lenses.io): licensing, support tier and term, in one document.

03Procurement

Purchase through IBM or TD Synnex, the distributor of the IBM Confluent ecosystem in Brazil, or via cloud marketplace when the customer prefers to consume committed spend.

04Delivery and operation

The same squad that sized and sold deploys, migrates and hands over. The license and the service have one owner.

Applies to Confluent Cloud, Confluent Platform and Lenses.io.
